name: GeneratedValue
summary: Produces a value at run time, so that a test needing something unique or unimportant does not have to invent one.

roles.name: GeneratedValue
roles.summary: A member that makes a fresh value on demand. It removes collisions between runs and buys them back as irreproducibility: a failure that depends on what was generated cannot be re-run unless what was generated is reported, which is the discipline this annotation exists to make askable.
